name: Rhode Island
agency: Rhode Island Department of Human Services (for EOHHS Medicaid)

period.description: Your spenddown is figured for a six-month period starting the first of the month you apply, and again at each renewal.

submission.description: Keep your medical bills and receipts and give them to the state agency (or have your provider send them). Medicaid covers you once your allowed costs reach the six-month spenddown.

notes: Paid and unpaid bills from the current period count, and unpaid older bills can count too.
Health insurance premiums, co-pays and deductibles count, but not premiums Medicaid already pays.
The part of a bill used for one spenddown cannot be used again later.
Home nursing or homemaker costs usually need approval first from an eligibility worker.

sources.title: RI Medicaid Provider Reference Manual: General Guidelines - EOHHS
